rows.en: Hehehe… Well, we're going mountain climbing! I can't sit still.
But… are you sure you don't mind taking them along?
Of course! Why don't you come with us too, Go?
Well… I just can't get any time off.
You really are busy, aren't you? Don't tell me there's been some incident…?
No…
Somehow… it feels like we're the only ones going off to play. Maybe we should skip it after all?
No, I'd really like you to take them! Jiro's been looking forward to this so much…
Oh… Even without you lot around, if anything happens, we'll put up a fine fight.
Even you're saying that, Mr. Tachibana…
Well then… I guess we'll take you up on that and go.
Seriously! Come with us, Go…
Hmm, so you're busy, huh? Don't tell me there's some incident…?
Somehow… it feels like we're the only ones going off to play. Maybe we should skip it after all?
Even you're saying that, Mr. Tachibana…
Well then… we'll take you up on that and be on our way.
Go… what do you want for a souvenir?

I'm not expecting anything…

Aki, be careful…
I'll be fine… See you later.
This is a vacation-home area deep in the mountains, far from the city. Set a little apart from the ski slopes, it was popular as a quiet retreat…
It is now late autumn… and at this time of year, there is never a shortage of couples and families coming for picnics.
So this monster Woo is an imaginary creature, like a sea goblin or a yuki-onna?
But… apparently the hunter insists on having definitely seen it…

They say snowy mountains can play tricks on the human mind, right?

The mystery of the mountains probably made the hunter see things.
I'd like to think so too.
Still, this is weird… It's nothing like the map, is it?
Come to think of it… Mt. Asama keeps getting farther and farther away.
Maybe a snow angel turned the signposts around, telling us that mountain's dangerous?
No… I can't help thinking someone's interfering with us.

…!?

What's that!?
It's the Legendary Monster Woo!
And more of them are showing up! I wish this was just an illusion…
The fact is, there have been three strange disappearances… at Yatsugatake, Karuizawa and Manza, one after another.
Disappearances? That's the Metropolitan Police's jurisdiction… Why is MAT involved?
Well… because we suspect the victims of those disappearances have vanished from this Earth.
From the face of the Earth?
What's more… only couples have been targeted, on holidays when they were out enjoying a late-autumn picnic.
Couples on picnics?
What's wrong?

No, nothing…

It can't be… I hope [HERO2] and the others are all right…
Man, you really saved us…
We'd gotten completely lost, you see.

Mt. Asama is a strange mountain, known as the phantom snow mountain.

For some reason, that mountain alone is covered in snow even in summer.
Is some unusual air current flowing into it?

Who knows…

Even the experts at the weather station call it a mystery zone and have thrown up their hands.

Hey, Ide!

What are you spacing out for? Are you still thinking about that girl from before?
A girl?

She said we were horrible people who call anything and everything a kaiju and kill it…

And then she pelted me with snow.
Ah… that'd be the "Yukinko," the snow child!
Yukinko…?
This Yukinko… who exactly is she?

Why, she's a proper human child, of course. She has a name, too: Yuki.

It was 15 years ago now… One night in a heavy snowfall, a mother and child collapsed in the village. No one knows where they came from.

The mother had long since died of hunger and cold, but for some reason, the baby alone was perfectly healthy.

But that only made the villagers fear her as the daughter of a "yuki-onna," and not one of them would take her in.
That's terrible…

In the end…

an old loner named Kisuke, who made charcoal at the foot of Mt. Asama, heard about it and raised her as his own…

But the old man passed away two years ago, and Yuki was left truly all alone.

On top of that, in this latest incident, the hunter who was attacked keeps insisting it was Yuki who called Woo…

So the villagers have been avoiding her more than ever.

I wonder how she gets by?

Actually, I lost my mother when I was young too…

Is that so…

Well, when you think about it… she is a poor child. But as long as there's this Woo business, we can't just feel sorry for her…
I see… Somehow, I feel like I understand how that girl feels…
I wonder if [HERO4] and her partner are all right?
They got mistaken for newlyweds and were taken to a different hut.
It's because Jiro made that weird joke! Now the two of them can't back out of it!
Tch… They didn't look like they minded!
Jiro…!
But… we've got the stove burning like crazy, so why is it so cold?
I knew it… I should have brought a thick sweater.
If you do this, you'll warm up…
Whoa…
Your hands are cold, Mari! That's not warming me up at all!
Jiro, how can you say that?
But…
I'm sorry, okay?
Even so, it really is cold.

"I'm an android… I can't warm Aki's and Jiro's bodies!

But… I want to do whatever I can for them."
Aren't you cold, Mari?
I'm fine…
Huh? It's starting to feel a bit warmer… Thanks, Mari.
"Can my energy converter withstand this cold? Still, for these two…"
It's really gotten cold, hasn't it…
Yes… By the way, what kind of legend is the legend of Woo?

The legend of Woo?

There's no such thing. There aren't any monsters around these parts.
No, but… we came here to investigate that very monster.

U13045: Mari's gesture (hands on Jiro) is implied; kept generic 'If you do this'.
U13052/U13056: Mari's inner thoughts in 『』 rendered in double quotes per brief.
